vulnerability.name: USN-5473-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5473-1 updated ca-certificates. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   The ca-certificates package contained outdated CA certificates. This update  refreshes the included certificates to those contained in the 2.50 version  of the Mozilla certificate authority bundle.

statements.status_notes: The CA certificates in the ca-certificates package were updated. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
